_meta.purpose: The five business functions Northstar itself designates as critical business services, per Bank_Context_Fictional_Digital_Bank.md (Digital Operational Resilience section). All five ARE formally designated - the document is explicit about that. The gap it describes is downstream, in dependency/subcontractor mapping, not in this designation register - see 05_operations/dependencies.json for that.

critical_or_important_functions.name: Customer Login and Account Access
critical_or_important_functions.designation_rationale: Sole channel for all customer interaction - the bank has no branches, so this is the front door to every other service.

critical_or_important_functions.name: Payments
critical_or_important_functions.designation_rationale: Continuity failure stops all outbound and inbound euro payments across mobile, web and API channels.

critical_or_important_functions.name: Customer Onboarding
critical_or_important_functions.designation_rationale: Statutory KYC/CDD gateway control; failure blocks all new customer acquisition across six markets.

critical_or_important_functions.name: Loan Origination
critical_or_important_functions.designation_rationale: Automated decisioning affects access to credit for retail and SME customers across six markets.

critical_or_important_functions.name: Mortgage Servicing
critical_or_important_functions.designation_rationale: Operated by a material third-party servicer; failure affects balance accuracy, arrears handling and vulnerable-customer protections for the entire Irish mortgage book.
